description: This header defines a TestSemaphore class for POSIX thread synchronization, including methods for semaphore operations, thread management, and related utilities, used for testing POSIX thread behavior in the starboard/nplb/posix namespace.

classes.name: TestSemaphore
classes.description: A POSIX thread semaphore class for testing, with methods to put, take, and try to take permits.

classes.name: WaiterContext
classes.description: A struct managing mutex and condition variables for thread synchronization in tests.

classes.name: TakeThenSignalContext
classes.description: An aggregate struct combining a semaphore, mutex, condition, and delay for specific test scenarios.

classes.name: AbstractTestThread
classes.description: A base class for creating test threads using pthreads, requiring subclasses to override Run().

methods.name: TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing permits to zero.

methods.name: TestSemaphore(int initial_thread_permits)
methods.description: Constructor initializing permits to a specified value.

methods.name: ~TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up mutex and condition variable.

methods.name: Put()
methods.description: Increments permits and signals waiting threads.

methods.name: Take()
methods.description: Blocks until permits > 0, then decrements permits.

methods.name: TakeTry()
methods.description: Attempts to decrement permits without blocking; returns success status.

methods.name: Wait()
methods.description: Waits on condition, updates waiters count.

methods.name: WaitForReturnSignal()
methods.description: Waits until unreturned_waiters > 0, then takes one.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be overridden by subclasses to define thread behavior.

methods.name: Start()
methods.description: Creates a pthread running the thread's Run() method.

methods.name: Join()
methods.description: Joins the thread, with failure handling.
